children: Robinhood Chain’s DeFi total value locked has reached $1.027 billion, up 60.47% over the past month and the fastest growth among major blockchains. According to ChainCatcher, the network also recorded $1.397 billion in DEX trading volume over the past 24 hours, ranking second across all chains behind Solana.
Robinhood Chain launched in early July and has become a major blockchain by TVL and trading activity in less than three months.

title: Robinhood Chain DeFi TVL Rises to $1.027 Billion as DEX Volume Reaches $1.397 Billion
